Not equity, not debt. | Gold and silver ETF fund-of-funds are no longer "specified
Metals FoFs: short-term losses (Bandhan Silver, Nippon Silver ×2, Mirae, Bandhan Gold) | −98,942
mutual funds" under Section 50AA for sales from 1-Apr-2025, because they don't
Metals FoFs: short-term gain (Axis Gold & Silver) | 37,246
hold over 65% in debt. Their gains are ordinary capital gains, not debt-style slab-
regardless-of-period.
Net short-term capital loss from metals (slab-rate pool) | −61,696
24-month rule. | As unlisted units, they turn long-term only after 24 months: 12.5%
Set off | against equity STCG (Mahindra Manulife, PGIM, HDFC; normally 20%) | 3,395
without indexation. Before that, gains are short-term and taxed at the investor's slab
Short-term loss still unabsorbed | −58,301 | rate. Every lot here was bought Dec-2025 to Sep-2026, so all are short-term.
Losses cross over. | A short-term capital loss can be set off | against any short-term or
Equity LTCG (Mahindra Manulife ₹56,523 + PGIM ₹28,228) | 84,751
long-term capital gain in the same year (Section 70). It absorbs the Axis gain (slab)
Less: remaining short-term loss set off | against LTCG | −58,301 | first, then the equity short-term gains, then part of the equity LTCG.

112A). It still applies to the equity LTCG left after set-off.

absorb it. Selling this year lets ₹98,942 of losses cancel the Axis gain and all

@@PAGE_BREAK 10
UNIVEST WEALTH | DEPLOYMENT PLAN
I M M E D I AT E D E P L O Y M E N T P L A N
What happens, day by day
Day 1 · Thu 25-Sep | Stop the old SIPs
Cancel the Regular-plan SIPs in Mahindra Manulife Multi Cap (8th), PGIM Flexi Cap (8th), Nippon Silver FoF (7th) and the ₹20/day HDFC Flexi Cap SIP. If an
October instalment still debits, redeem those units with the tranche.
Day 2–3 · Fri 26 – Mon 29-Sep | Redeem all 9 folios
Redeem every folio in full. Place all nine redemptions in the same | financial year, and ideally together, so the metals losses and equity gains fall in FY 2026-27 and
cancel out. Proceeds reach the bank in 1–3 working days.
Day 4–6 · by Fri 3-Oct | Deploy the lumpsum
Invest ₹15,77,657 across the eight Direct funds on the Buy page, all on the same day. Put Edelweiss Mid Cap in last to absorb any difference in proceeds. Nothing
is parked in a liquid fund.
By 10-Oct | Register the new SIPs
Register ₹7,600/month across | five Direct funds, with the | first instalments in October and one debit date around the 5th–10th.
If markets fall | Contingency
If the Nifty Midcap 150 or Smallcap 250 falls 10% or more, keep the SIPs running. Any surplus savings can go into Edelweiss Mid Cap or Bandhan Small Cap as a
one-off | top-up. Gold is not topped up; it stays a hedge at about 13%.
Mar-2027 / Sep-2027 | Reviews
Half-yearly check in Mar-2027 on fund performance vs category and gold weight (rebalance if it drifts above 18%). Full annual review in Sep-2027 with a fresh
statement.
